paite: Manasseh alal pat tung in kum sawm-le-nih a upa ahi. Jerusalem ah kum sawmnga-le-nga alal a; anu min Hephzibah ahi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Manasseh / (2 Kro 33.1-20)

paite: TOUPA'N Israel suante ma a adelhkhiaksa namte, thilkihhuaitak ahihte uh bang, TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih hi.
Apa Hezekiah in ahihsiatsa mun sangte adingsak nawn a; Israel kumpipa Ahab hih bang in Baal maitamte adingsak a, Asherahte abawl a, van a om tengteng bia in a-nna uh asem hi.
TOUPA'N, "Jerusalem ah ka min ka omsak ding," achihna TOUPA' inn ah maitamte abawl hi.
TOUPA' inn huangsung intual nihte ah van a om tengteng a ding in maitamte abawl hi.
Atapa mei ah apaisuaksak a, aisan leh bum ahih a, dawi zawlte leh kha napeuh adong hi. TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou thupi mahmah amah hehsak ding in ahih hi.
TOUPA'N David leh atapa Solomon kiang a, "Hiai inn leh Jerusalem khua, Israel chi tengteng lak a ka tel ah ka min tangtawn in ka omsak ding," achihna mun ah Asherah lim khuaktawm atungkhia hi.
"Thu ka piak tengteng leh ka sikha Mosi in dan apiak tengteng zuih peuhmah uleh api-le-pute uh ka piaksa gam a pan Israelte khete leng ka kal ka suankhesak nawn sam kei ding," achi hi.
Himahleh amau azui kei ua; TOUPA'N Israel suante ma a delhkhiaksa namte hih sang tham a thupizaw thil hihkhial ding in Manasseh in mite alampialsak hi.
TOUPA'N asikha zawlneite zang in thu agen hi.
"Judah kumpipa Manasseh in hiai thilkihhuaitakte ahih a, Amorte sang tham in ahihkhial thupi hi. Judahte'n leng amilimte a thil ahihkhelhsak ziak in," achi hi.
TOUPA, Israel Pathian in hichi in achi, "Ngai dih ua, Jerusalem leh Judah tung ah aza peuhmahte bil langnih khengzou khop in thil hoih lou ka hon tungsak ding hi.
Jerusalem tung ah Samaria tehna khau leh Ahab inkuan' ulum khai ka khung dia; mi'n akuangnul akilumletsak bang in Jerusalem ka nul ding hi.
Ka goutan khosuaksunte ka taisan dia, amelmate uh khut ah ka pe ding.
Huchi in api-le-pute uh Aigupta gam a pan ahong pawt nung uh tuni pha a ka mitmuh a thil hoih lou ahih ua, hon hehsak ziak un, amelma tengteng mat ding leh gallak ding ahi ding uh," chi in achi hi.
TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih loutak hih a Judahte thil ahihkhelhsak, khelhna a sim lou in Manasseh in poi khoih lou sisan nakpitak in asuah lai a, Jerusalem dung leh vai adimsak hi.
Manasseh tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng, athilhihkhelhte Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Huchi in Manasseh api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, Uzza huansung a om ama inn huan mah ah avui ua; asik in atapa Ammon alalta hi.
Ammon alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nih a upa ahi. Jerusalem ah kum nih alal a; anu min Mesullemeth, Jotbah a Haruz tanu ahi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Ammon

paite: Apa Manasseh hih bangmah TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih loutak ahih hi.
Apa lampi tot tengteng atawn sam a, apa septe milimte nna sem in amaute abia hi.
Huchi in TOUPA, api-le-pute Pathian apaisan a, TOUPA lampi atawn kei hi.
Ammon sikhate'n amah aguksawm ua, kumpipa amah inn ah athatta uhi.
Himahleh huai gam a mite'n kumpipa Ammon guksawm mi tengteng athat vek uhi. Huchi in huai gam mite'n atapa Josiah asik in kumpipa in abawlta uhi.
Huchi in Ammon thilhih tanchin dangte Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Uzza huan a amah han ah avui ua; asik in atapa Josiah alalta hi.
